INDEPENDENT INSPECTION REPORT
Inspector: Hammond Engineering, P.E. (engaged jointly per parties' agreement, 12/18/2023)
Project: Riverton Hotel Renovation, 88 Waterfront Drive
Inspection Date: 12/20/2023
Inspector: Robert Hammond, P.E., License #WB-PE-22198

SCOPE:
Visual and selective destructive inspection of Phase 2 work scope (HVAC rough-in, framing, MEP rough-in) referenced in AFP 6.

FINDINGS:
1. HVAC rough-in: Compliant with submitted shop drawings. No deficiencies observed.
2. Framing: Two (2) minor deviations from drawings on Floor 3 (non-load-bearing wall location moved approximately 6 inches). Field-verified change discussed with Owner's representative on 6/14/2023 per Daily Report 6/14. Not a code deficiency.
3. MEP rough-in: Compliant. One outlet box mislocated in Room 312, field-correctable, est. $180.

OPINION:
The Phase 2 work as inspected is substantially in conformance with the contract documents. Deficiencies identified are de minimis and total approximately $1,200 in field corrections.

The condition of the Phase 2 work does not support withholding of $1.247M in progress payments for AFPs 6, 7, and 8.

/s/ Robert Hammond, P.E.
12/22/2023
